chapter: Childhood in Tyler, Beaumont and Houston
title: The street band and circus drummers that made him want to play
summary: He loved a string band rehearsing up the street and circus bands, and the drummer especially made him want to play drums.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Well, I just love music, you know? And whenever -- it was a band right up the street from me, a
little string band. They used to -- like, on a Saturday they would come out and rehearse, which would be a bass, guitar and trumpet and trombone, you know.
I was quite young then, see.
And I used to listen to them.
And every time the circus came in town, I would always love to be around the band.
Especially when I'd hear the drummer playing. That got to me.
Right away, that got to you.
Did the thing for me right there.
You know, I went to pieces, you know.
Because I wanted to play the drum.
How old would you be then, like? Seven or eight or something, or more than that?
No, I was younger than that.
When you were really small, you had that --
